name: Lift.KummerChart.PairingSide.exists_lift_of_mem_liftIdeal
summary: Split f = r·t₀ + s₀ with s₀ in the colon ideal; lift s₀·y in the extension and retract to the Kisin module with coordRetract, which replaces t₀ by λ₀(t₀).

steps.claim: From H, f = r·t₀ + s₀ with s₀ in the colon ideal (mem_span_singleton_sup); take t = λ₀(t₀) ∈ S (λ₀ = coord₀).

For y ∈ locLetterPart(trivLattice(S), l, i): y lies in the A_inf-span of the letter projections of 1 ⊗ C (tau_pow_smul_mem_ainfLattice_of_chi with c = 0: C has the trivial action), so s₀·y = projTriv(S)(x) for some x with the standard exponents of level l (the colon condition); then coordRetract(x) ∈ locLetterPart(extLattice(S), l, i) (coordRetract_mem_withExponents) and projTriv(S)(coordRetract(x)) = coordRetract(s₀·y) (map_coordRetract) = λ₀(s₀)·y = (f − r·λ₀(t₀))·y, λ₀ being S-linear and the identity on S (coord₀_coe).
steps.lean:
fun t ⟨s, H, e⟩ y ⟨m, hy⟩ ↦
  (H ⟨y, ⟨_, tau_pow_smul_mem_ainfLattice_of_chi 0 (mem_withExponents_of_le
  hy), by simp [mem_letterPart_iff_letterProj.1 hy.1.2]⟩, rfl⟩).rec fun x ⟨hx, q⟩ ↦ ⟨_,
  ⟨Submodule.coe_mem _, coordRetract_mem_withExponents ⟨_, hx.1.1⟩ hx⟩, by
  simp [↓S.projTriv.map_coordRetract ⟨x, _⟩ ⟨_, smul_mem _ s m.1⟩ q, coordRetract, eq_sub_of_add_eq'
    e, k.coord₀_coe, exists_coordRetract.choose_spec _ _ m, ↓← map_nsmul, mul_comm]; rfl⟩
